items.stem: In the past, people often used m______ to light candles.
items.note: 阅读部分第1题（卷面 1）；题干已印首字母 m，横线手写 atches，即 matches

items.stem: I stand in front of my father in s______ because I told a lie just now.
items.note: 卷面 2；题干已印首字母 s，手写形似 hame（a/o 难辨），应为 shame

items.stem: I r______ the chair from my bedroom yesterday as it was useless.
items.note: 卷面 3；题干已印首字母 r，横线手写 emoved，即 removed

items.stem: Be really careful when making friends with others online, or you will be c______.
items.note: 卷面 4；题干已印首字母 c，横线手写 heated，即 cheated

items.stem: The new rule sounds great, but it may cause a lot of trouble when we put it into p______.
items.note: 卷面 5；题干已印首字母 p，横线手写 ractice，即 practice

items.stem: She looked at the painting with a______ and couldn't move her eyes away from it.
items.note: 卷面 6；题干已印首字母 a，横线手写 dmiration，即 admiration

items.stem: Finally, he decided not to keep the fish ______ to set it free.
items.note: 卷面 7；左侧页边手写大写 D（学生作答）；选项本身无勾画

items.stem: The boy felt very ______ because he did something wrong.
items.note: 卷面 8；左侧页边手写大写 B（学生作答）

items.stem: Riding bicycles is a great way to go around and ______ our bodies.
items.note: 卷面 9；左侧页边手写大写 C（学生作答）

items.stem: I have ______ to tell you. Let's keep it as a secret between us.
items.note: 卷面 10；左侧页边手写大写 A（学生作答）；选项按 AB/CD 两行排布，已理顺

items.stem: Every time ______ I see China's national flag rising, I have a sense of pride from the bottom of my heart.
items.note: 卷面 11；左侧页边手写大写 D（学生作答）

items.stem: The young pianist played the difficult piece as ______ as an experienced musician.
items.note: 卷面 12；左侧页边手写大写 C（学生作答）

items.stem: —Tony wasn't chosen for the team. That was a bad ______. —You're right. We can't win the game without him.
items.note: 卷面 13；左侧页边手写大写 C（学生作答）；题干为两行对话，已合并

items.stem: —How about playing computer games? —That sounds ______. Let's play basketball.
items.note: 语法部分第1题（卷面 1，连续编号为 14）；左侧页边手写大写 B（学生作答），字母纵跨该行与上一行之间，按行高判定属本题

items.stem: The new bed ______ very hard.  I couldn't sleep well last night.
items.note: 语法部分第2题（卷面 2，连续编号为 15）；左侧页边手写大写 C（学生作答）

items.stem: Though we sometimes argue with each other, we ______ ______.
items.cn: 尽管我们有时互相争吵，但我们仍是朋友。
items.note: 语法部分第3题（卷面 3，连续编号为 16）；卷面为两个空，依次手写 still、friends（缺系动词 are）；中文句下「我们仍是朋友」被铅笔圈画

items.stem: 你穿这条裙子看上去很漂亮。
handwriting: You look beautiful in this dress.
items.note: 语法部分第4题（卷面 4，连续编号为 17）；手写译文照抄

items.stem: People were ______(doubt) whether this was a safe or accurate way.
items.note: 页顶为短文语法填空（属本卷上一页末段，原文前半未拍到），此为其第1空；手写 doubtful。本页该部分题号与「阅读」1-6 重复，故连续编号为 18

items.stem: Doctors needed a tool ______(check) fevers, and scientists needed one to study heat.
items.note: 同上一题短文第2空；手写潦草，疑为 to check

items.stem: A better way to measure temperature ______(need).
items.note: 短文第3空；手写字迹潦草（形似 in need / is needed），无法确认

items.stem: The thermometer helps us ______ many ways.
items.note: 短文第4空；该空（含可能的括号提示）被白色涂改带整块遮挡，仅见左右两侧 helps us 与 many ways，故题干只保留空格

items.stem: Cooks use it for baking, ______. Factories use it to keep machines safe.
items.note: 短文第5空；空及提示被白色涂改带遮挡（涂改带上有手写字迹，形似 Mony），无法确认；右侧 Factories 的 Fa 亦被覆盖

items.stem: It ______(apply) to many aspects of our daily lives, bringing great convenience.
items.note: 短文第6空；该空未见手写作答
